it may not be the best to you, it may not be perfection that you’d expect but we personally really enjoyed the experience and we would go back again on our next trip :) or just grab order it since it is a few metro stops away from where we usually stay :) 

Nutrition: 
C: 8 | F: 9 | P: 34
Calories: 255 per serving 
Serves 3

Ingredients
450 grams chicken mince
1 tsp sesame oil
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp minced ginger
4-5 birds eye chilli, chopped ( adjust as per your personal spice level )
1 green capsicum, small cubes 
200 grams button mushroom, sliced and cooked 
1 tbsp oyster sauce (ignore if you dont need it)
2 tbsp soy sauce ( light is better but if you have dark, i use 1 tbsp dark + 1 tbsp water )
1 tbsp vinegar
1 tbsp vegetable stock powder ( use 1/4 cup water if you dont have) 
large handful of basil leaves

Method 
add oil to a pan then add in ginger garlic and saute
add in the mince and allow to cook 3/4th atleast
add in capsicum and mushrom( i cooked my mushrooms in advance because i prefer it but you can add it to the pot and let it cook) 
add in the soy + vinegar + vege stock powder 
add in the sliced basil leaves and let it simmer for a few minutes till ready 

serve with steamed rice + fried egg
